summary: PCE inflation came in hotter than expected at a three-year high, pushing the interest rate market to price in a 30% chance of a Fed rate hike next month, with a full hike priced for October.
tweet: Hot inflation data, a firmer dollar, and rising Fed rate-hike expectations are slamming gold and crypto into Fear while an AI selloff drags cap-weighted stocks — bonds alone catching a safe-haven bid.
